note: Spec §17. The 2026 Belgian B2B mandate is the rule most likely to move; treat `last_reviewed` as load-bearing and re-read the source before relying on any conclusion drawn from these.

rules.title: No structured e-invoice generation is visible
rules.requirement: Belgian established taxable persons must issue structured electronic invoices for domestic B2B supplies, in a format compliant with the European standard, exchanged over an interoperable network.
rules.impact: Domestic B2B customers subject to the mandate cannot lawfully receive a PDF-only invoice. A product that cannot issue a structured invoice cannot serve them.
rules.recommendation: Generate a compliant structured document from the same domain model that produces the PDF, and validate it against the business rules before delivery.
rules.verification_test: Generate a structured invoice and validate it against the format's business-rule set.

rules.title: No participant identifier handling is visible
rules.requirement: Exchange over the network requires each party to be addressed by a participant identifier in a registered scheme, and the recipient to be discoverable before an invoice is sent.
rules.impact: Without recipient lookup, delivery fails after the invoice is already issued and the customer is told it was sent.
rules.recommendation: Resolve and store the recipient identifier, and check registration before issuing.
rules.verification_test: Attempt delivery to an unregistered recipient; expect a clear pre-issue failure.
